overview_description.description:
Eclipse Foods is plant-based dairy products that are indistinguishable from animal dairy products. Using a novel plant-processing technology, Eclipse gives amazing dairy flavor, texture, and functionality without the health, environmental, and welfare issues attached to traditional dairy. The company's mission is to create a more sustainable, healthy, and humane food system by making amazing plant-based foods that require no sacrifice.

Eclipse Foods was founded in 2019 and is based in Oakland, California.

about_short_description.short_description: Eclipse Foods is a food manufacturing company that provides plant-based ice cream and dairy products with taste and texture.

product.name: Eclipse Plant-Based Ice Cream
product.description: Vegan ice cream designed to replicate the taste, texture, and functionality of conventional dairy ice cream. Available for retail and foodservice applications in flavors such as Vanilla Bean, Classic Chocolate, Mint Choco Chip, and Mango Passion Fruit.

product.name: Eclipse Non-Dairy Whole Milk
product.description: A shelf-stable, plant-based whole-milk alternative supplied in 32-fluid-ounce Tetra Pak cartons for beverage and culinary applications.

product.name: Eclipse Liquid Ice Cream Mix
product.description: Liquid, plant-based ice cream mixes for commercial soft-serve and custom dessert applications, offered in Vanilla Soft Serve, Chocolate Soft Serve, and Plain Dessert Blend varieties.

product.name: Eclipse Hard Pack Ice Cream
product.description: Plant-based hard-pack ice cream supplied in commercial 3-gallon tubs for scooping, dessert assembly, and other foodservice applications.

product.name: Chef Collaboration Ice Creams
product.description: Limited or past plant-based ice cream flavors developed with chefs and restaurants, including Roasted Plantain Coconut Cream & Salted Caramel and Toasted Almond Thyme.

identifier.value: Foodservice Menu Integration and Account Support

product.name: Foodservice Menu Integration and Account Support
product.description: Foodservice support that helps operators add Eclipse products to menus, including product-format guidance, operational integration, marketing, and merchandising assistance.
